title: Project Charter Integration and Multi-Factor Ranking Architecture Reset
track: Track A (quant brain) — architecture reset. No model built. No live provider call. No commit. No push.
summary: Adopts docs/project_charter_sp500_multifactor_ranking_v1.md as the governing architecture and resets the project away from single-signal prediction hunting toward a two-system institutional design: System 1 = multi-factor cross-sectional ranking engine, System 2 = regime/risk-throttle overlay, measured by a validation harness that is built FIRST. Produces the 7B-7E implementation roadmap.

charter.non_negotiable_rule: Judgment calls (factor selection, weighting, backtest interpretation) are surfaced with options + visible reasoning for owner endorsement, never silently buried in code.

architecture_reset.from: single-name directional prediction with confidence (5-20 day price-only champion + event/macro wrappers)
architecture_reset.to: two-layer system — System 1 ranking engine (WHICH names) under System 2 regime/risk throttle (HOW MUCH risk + WHICH factor buckets)
architecture_reset.sequencing_principle: Build the validation harness (the measuring instrument) FIRST; build and trust System 1 over months before adding System 2; never hedge a book whose net exposures are not yet measured.
architecture_reset.scoring_discipline: Cross-sectional z-score each factor, winsorize at +/-3, sector-neutralize, EQUAL WEIGHT first (no early weight optimization).

roadmap.title: Validation Harness Foundation
roadmap.charter_mapping: Phase 0 (backtest harness, build FIRST) + Phase 1 (point-in-time data foundation)
roadmap.objective: Build the measuring instrument before any factor or model: a point-in-time data foundation plus a purged walk-forward backtest harness reporting the full metrics suite and the three anti-self-deception safeguards.

roadmap.title: Multi-Factor Ranking Engine
roadmap.charter_mapping: Phase 2 (single-factor compute) + Phase 3 (composite scoring, equal weight)
roadmap.objective: Compute the six single-name factor buckets, normalize cross-sectionally, combine EQUAL WEIGHT into a composite rank of the S&P 500 (System 1). No weight optimization.

roadmap.title: Risk Decomposition
roadmap.objective: Decompose every position into separable exposures (market beta, rate/duration, sector/factor, idiosyncratic) and aggregate to a whole-book consolidated risk view. Measurement only — no hedging.

roadmap.title: Regime Overlay
roadmap.objective: Macro-indicator regime classifier (risk-on/neutral/risk-off) that throttles how much risk and which factor buckets — a posture overlay on System 1, never a standalone oracle. Gated on System 1 being trusted and on cross-asset data (Phase 6-B/6-C collection).

factor_inventory_summary.note: Macro indicators drive System 2 only; they do NOT score individual tickers.

three_safeguards: out-of-sample is a spent budget (single-touch holdout, purged CV with embargo)

what_we_stop_doing: prediction-oracle framing (single-name directional prediction with confidence)
Paper Trader / GCP / deploy / broker / order / automation work
live provider calls in this phase
what_we_build_next: Phase 7B — Validation Harness Foundation: a point-in-time data layer (yfinance, FRED, SEC EDGAR) plus a purged walk-forward harness (reusing the audited Phase 5-C machinery) that produces deflated-Sharpe / config-count / per-regime / cost-adjusted OOS metrics against an equal-weight benchmark, BEFORE any factor or ranking work begins.

gates.note: root CLAUDE.md references the charter as project constitution
all four required phases defined with charter mappings and exit criteria
reset reframes the system as ranking + risk monitoring, not a prediction oracle (charter Section 2)
no weight optimization scheduled before the validation framework is trusted and the owner endorses (charter Section 5)
weighting / factor-selection / interpretation decisions are flagged as owner-endorsed judgment calls, not buried (charter Section 1)
planning artifacts only; no model trained or built this phase
zero network; no provider call; no Alpha Vantage
artifacts written to working tree only; not staged, committed, or pushed

recommendation_rationale: The charter is in-repo and adopted as the constitution, CLAUDE.md points to it, and the 7B-7E roadmap honors charter sequencing (harness first, equal weight first, System 1 before System 2). No charter contradiction was found, so no NEEDS_CHARTER_REVIEW. The honest next step is to build the validation harness foundation (Phase 7B), the measuring instrument every later phase is judged against.
commit_note: The four Phase 7A artifacts plus the ADR are isolated, text-only, and commit-worthy on their own, but per task instruction nothing is committed or pushed. Any future commit should stage only docs/adr_phase7a_ranking_engine_reset.md and research/output/phase7a_ranking_engine_reset/*, and must NOT sweep in the pre-existing unrelated modified output files in the working tree.
